range.preliminary_note: This is a ballpark, not a quote — it's built from your rough dimensions using the same rates we price every job with, and matches the ranges published at enduredecks.com.au/pricing. Site access, levels, subframe height and final board choice move the number inside this range. One site consult locks it to a fixed price that doesn't change.
